blocks.text: Compound lipids fatty acids ke aise alcohols ke saath esters hain jin mein koi izafi group ho, jaise phosphate, nitrogen wala base, carbohydrate ya protein.

items: Phospholipids charbi jaise hain lekin glycerol se sirf do fatty acids jure hote hain; glycerol ka teesra OH phosphate group se jura hota hai, jo molecule ko polar banata hai. Hydrocarbon dumein hydrophobic hain, jab ke phosphate group aur us se jure hisse paani pasand (hydrophilic) sar banate hain. Paani mein dalne par phospholipids dohri teh, 'bilayer', banate hain, polar sire bahar aur non-polar sire andar ikatthe; yahi tamam cell jhilliyon ki banawat hai. Kuch liposomes masnoo phospholipid thailiyan hain jo paani mein ghulne wali dawaiyan pohanchane mein use hoti hain.

blocks.alt: Baen: phospholipid ka gol hydrophilic (paani pasand) sar aur do hydrophobic (paani se door) dumein. Daen: block diagram jis mein glycerol aik fatty acid, doosre fatty acid, aur phosphate (PO4) se jura hai jo aik alcohol se juri hai.
blocks.caption: Figure 27.11: Phospholipids ki bunyadi banawat (kitab ki Figure 27.11 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Dono hisse aik hi molecule hain: block diagram ke do fatty acids hi do hydrophobic dumein hain, aur glycerol se juri PO4 aur alcohol hydrophilic sar hain. Paani mein yeh molecules dumein andar aur sar bahar kar ke bilayer banate hain.

items: Lipoproteins lipids aur proteins ke complexes hain jo hydrophobic lipids (jaise cholesterol aur triglycerides) ko khoon mein le jate hain.
Glycolipids woh lipids hain jin se carbohydrate (shakar) groups jure hon, zyada tar asab ke tissue mein.

blocks.title: Kya aap jante hain?
blocks.text: Liposomes paani mein ghulne wali cancer ki dawaiyon ke achhe haamil hain: lipid bilayer aik aabi markaz ko gherti hai jis mein dawa hoti hai, use tootne se bachati, cells mein dakhil hone mein madad deti aur rasoli ke cells tak pohancha sakti hai.

blocks.alt: Liposome: aik gola jis ki deewar lipid bilayer hai, laal sar bahar ke paani aur andar ke aabi markaz ki taraf aur dumein darmiyan mein. Hare hydrophilic dawa ke zarre aabi markaz (aqueous core) mein; neele lipophilic dawa ke zarre bilayer ke andar. Labels: aqueous core, lipidic bilayer, hydrophilic drug, lipophilic drug.
blocks.caption: Liposome (kitab ke Did You Know box ki liposome tasveer ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.prompt: Phospholipids paani mein bilayer kyun banate hain?
blocks.explanation: Har molecule ka hydrophilic (polar) sar aur hydrophobic (non-polar) dumein hain; paani mein sar dono taraf paani ki taraf aur dumein dohri teh ke andar paani se chhupi rehti hain.

items: Compound lipids mein izafi group (phosphate, base, shakar, protein).
Phospholipids: polar sar, do non-polar dumein; jhilliyon mein bilayers.
Lipoproteins khoon mein lipids le jate; glycolipids asab ke tissue mein.
